question: The material of a solid right circular cylinder is converted into the shape of a solid cone of equal radius. If the height of the cylinder was 4.5 cm, then the height of the cone is:
solution:
**Given:**

The volume of the right circular cylinder = The volume of a cone of equal radius

Height of the cylinder(H) =4.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

The volume of the right circular cylinder = pi times r² times H

The volume of the cone = (1)/(3)times pi times r² times h

**Calculations:**

According to the questions,

⇒ (1)/(3)times pi times r² times h = pi times r² times H 

⇒ h = 4.5 x 3= 13.5 cm

**Hence, The height of cone will be 13.5 cm**
